[{{fullurl:File:Flame Temple Corridor non-interactive map.jpg|redirect=no}} Non-interactive map] | ingame name=Flame Temple Corridor | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=106 }} The [[Flame Temple Corridor]] refers to a small blasted area in the northern part of [[Charr]]-held [[Ascalon]]. Most of it is a desolate set of gullies winding between surrounding hills. The Charr appeared to have converted the ruins' entirety into a makeshift temple, in which they perform ritual sacrifice at an altar. While Charr presence is strong in and around the temple complex, the occasional [[Hydra (Ascalon)|Hydra]] groups can be found prowling the edges. == Getting there == To reach this explorable area, you must travel through the [[tar]] pit in the northeastern part of [[Diessa Lowlands]]. The nearest outpost is [[Grendich Courthouse]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: *Southwest, at the exit into [[Diessa Lowlands]]. *Northeast, a short distance west of the exit into [[Dragon's Gullet]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{w}} 7 (20) [[Ascalon Striker]] *{{r}} 7 (20) Ascalon Striker ===Foes=== [[Charr]]s *{{w}} 8 (23) [[Charr Axe Fiend]] *{{w}} 8 (23) [[Charr Blade Storm]] *{{r}} 8 (23) [[Charr Hunter]] *{{mo}} 7 (23) [[Charr Shaman]] *{{n}} 8 (23) [[Charr Ashen Claw]] *{{me}} 8 (23) [[Charr Chaot]] *{{e}} 8 (23) [[Charr Flame Wielder]] [[Hydra]]s *{{e}} 10 (24) [[Hydra (Ascalon)|Hydra]] ==Notes== {{gw2w|Flame Temple Tombs}} *[[Interactive object]]s **[[Charr Altar]] *The following quests may affect the spawns in this area: **[[Althea's Ashes]] **[[The Titan Source]] (You will encounter one of the Charr bosses listed under the quest data, guarding the Altar) * The [[charr]] and [[hydra]] in the southeast corner are hostile to each other. *A squad of four [[Ascalon Striker|Ascalon soldiers]] will start heading towards the temple (specifically, the [[Charr Altar]]) in a slow walk. They usually die rather quickly if left alone, especially in [[hard mode]]. If they manage to reach the altar, they will simply wander around it. *Mid-level groups arriving here for quests should find the isolated [[Charr]] groups around the temple complex to be manageable. Be careful when moving in towards the altar though, aggroing two or three groups may easily wipe a party. Pick the groups off one-by-one by pulling them. *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.5% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 100|low = 96|high = 122|notes=Has hidden [[Devourer]]s.}} **Consider taking advantage of the four Ascalon soldiers against the first few groups. But given that the foes near the temple complex should be pulled carefully, it may be better to use them as bait or as additional corpses. **Also consider starting from [[Yak's Bend]] to benefit from a [[party]] size of 6. **With patience, it is possible to bring a party of eight from [[Temple of the Ages]]. * During [[Special Ops: Flame Temple Corridor]], you will be transported to an alternative version of the area. {{Explorable areas in Ascalon}} [[de:Flammentempel-Gang]]
